shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && find .agents -type f | head -50

cat AGENTS.md | head -40; find src -type f | xargs ls -la; cat src/*.tsx | head -60; grep -n -i -E "modal|dialog|confirm" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -20; wc -l .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Dialog Modal ThemeProvider

sed -n 1,45p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; sed -n 165,185p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head
npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | tail -8; npm view @gravity-ui/components peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/components dist-tags
npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.24.1 peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.24.1 dependencies

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | grep -o '"4\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tr -d '"' | tail -15); do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null)"; done; npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.24.1 --json | grep -i -c ConfirmDialog

npm install @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 2>&1 | tail -5; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/components/ConfirmDialog 2>&1

grep -n -i -B2 -A8 "required setup\|styles" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/README.md | head -40; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build -ipath "*confirmdialog*" -name "*.d.ts" -o -ipath "*confirmdialog*" -name "README*" | head; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json
